title: The First Empire
text: The oldest known civilization, also called the Old Empire or the Ancients. It had automated factories, satellites, genetic engineering, giant robots, and space elevators, and its ruins, labs, and libraries lie scattered across the world. Its writing can no longer be read, and how it ended is unknown.

title: The War of Behemoths
text: At some point the First Empire fought a war against an enemy whose identity is unclear. It used weapons so powerful that their owners came to fear them, among them the Behemoths: giant Skeletons many times the height of ordinary ones.

title: Obedience
text: After the war, the Ancients feared the Behemoths and turned their unquestioning loyalty against them, ordering them down into a great pit of molten metal that sealed them in. The place, Obedience, lies in the north of the Fog Islands, where giant Skeleton heads still rise from the ground.

title: Stobe
text: Stobe's Gamble and Stobe's Garden are named for Stobe, a giant Skeleton whose remains lie in Stobe's Garden. The Skeleton Bandits revere him as a deity, and many Skeletons grow sad near his remains, but what he was and what he did are unknown.

title: The Chaos Age
text: A time of calamities, rumored to include dangerous activity in the sky, natural disasters, plagues, and a Skeleton rebellion, in which the First Empire fell. What happened, and how it relates in time to Obedience, is unclear.

title: The Second Empire
text: Some time after the Chaos Age, Cat-Lon and his Skeleton followers founded an empire, in what are now the Ashlands, to rebuild civilization and to atone for the past. It grew dictatorial: child prisons, crackdowns on cults, and the killing of its own citizens turned the people against it, and a great famine brought it to the brink. It later collapsed, and its remnants under Cat-Lon became the Second Empire Exiles.

title: The Hydraulic Knights
text: A Skeleton military order of the Second Empire, led by General Jang, that fought the empire's outside enemies, such as pirates and cannibals. The cannibal tribes named Jang 'The Inedible One'.

title: The Founding of the Holy Nation
text: Legends say that while the Second Empire crumbled, a great leader called the Phoenix, champion of Okran and keeper of the Holy Flame, rallied humans in rebellion. His movement founded the Holy Nation, which is said to be over five thousand years old.

title: The Red Rebellion
text: After an uprising known as the Red Rebellion, the United Cities chose Tengu as its new emperor, a far more impulsive man than his predecessor. A book of the same name is sold in the Empire's shops.

title: Kral and the Shek Wars
text: Kral, a legendary warrior, united the warring Shek tribes into one kingdom centuries ago, and the Shek have raided their neighbors ever since. Under Shager, the kingdom bled itself in great, futile assaults on the Holy Nation.

title: The Shek Extinction Crisis
text: After Shager, Esata the Stone Golem became the first Shek ruler to face the kingdom's shrinking numbers. She seeks to weaken the Holy Nation before attacking it, so that the Shek do not fight themselves extinct, and this has divided her warriors.

title: The Slave Economy
text: Slavery is legal in the United Cities and practiced by the Holy Nation. The Slave Traders capture and work slaves, the Traders Guild runs the camps of the United Cities through the Noble Circle, and Manhunters bring back those who escape. The Anti-Slavers under Tinfist fight the trade with raids.

title: The Hive Queens
text: Every Hive is ruled by its Queen and her Princes, and only the Queen lays eggs. Hivers bound to her scent live for the Hive; one who drifts too long loses the bond, becomes Hiveless, and cannot return. The Western Hive and the Southern Hive each have a living Queen.

title: Okran and Narko
text: The Book of Sacrifice tells of Chitrin, a kind god whose people lost faith in him. As his power waned, calamities struck, and he sacrificed himself to end them, reborn as two gods in balance: Okran of day, warmth, and renewal, and Narko of night, cold, and destruction. The Holy Nation teaches that Okran cast Narko into the underworld, worships him alone, and bans the worship of Chitrin. Because Narko is female, it keeps women down, and it hates Skeletons as her agents. The Flotsam Ninjas honor both gods as parts of one balance.

title: The Fleshless Doctrine
text: The belief of the Skin Bandits that every living being is a Skeleton under its flesh, and that peeling away the flesh sets the true self free.

title: Ancient Technology
text: The machines of the Ancients still work in the ruins, guarded by security spiders, but no one knows how to build them. Ancient science books and AI cores are prized clues to that lost knowledge, sought by the Tech Hunters and studied by the Machinists of World's End.

title: Kenshi is a Moon
text: Kenshi is an unnamed moon, tidally locked to the giant planet in its sky. The Preacher Cult worships the moons and believes they bring blood rain for a good harvest.
